specs.title: API-0059: Delete product without a token returns 401

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send DELETE /products/{productId} with that id, without an Authorization header.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized".

specs.title: API-0060: Delete product with an invalid token returns 401

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send DELETE /products/{productId} with that id, with an invalid token.
Verify the response status is 401.
Verify the body's message is "Unauthorized".

specs.title: API-0061: Delete product as a non-admin user returns 403

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send DELETE /products/{productId} with that id, with the default user's token.
Verify the response status is 403.
Verify the body's message is "Forbidden".

specs.title: API-0058: Admin deletes a product

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send DELETE /products/{productId} with that id, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 204.
Verify GET /products/{productId} with that id returns 404.

specs.title: API-0062: Delete product with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send DELETE /products/{productId} with a well-formed ULID that no product has, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0023: Related products are other products from the same category

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's id.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id and take its category id.
Send GET /products/{productId}/related with that id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body is an array with at most 10 items.
Verify no item has the requested product's id.
Verify every item's category id equals the product's category id.
Verify every item's category has id and name.

specs.title: API-0020: Get product returns the product with its category, brand, image and specs

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's id and name.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's id equals that id and its name equals that name.
Verify the body has description, price, is_location_offer, is_rental, co2_rating, in_stock, is_eco_friendly, product_image, and a brand with id and name.
Verify the category has id, name, slug and parent_id.
Verify specs is an array and every spec has id, product_id, spec_name, spec_value and spec_unit.
Verify in_stock is a boolean.

specs.title: API-0022: Get product with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send GET /products/{productId} with a well-formed ULID that no product has.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0021: Get product with an admin token returns the stock count

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's id.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id, with the admin's token.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify in_stock is a number.

specs.title: API-0001: Search by name returns only matching products

steps.title: Send GET /products/search with q=pliers.
Verify the response status is 200 and the body is paginated (data, total, current_page).
Verify total is greater than 0 and every item's name contains "pliers" (case-insensitive).
Verify each item has an id, a name and a price greater than 0.

specs.title: API-0026: Search page 2 returns the second page

steps.title: Send GET /products/search with q=pliers and page=2.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify current_page is 2.

specs.title: API-0027: Search for a term no product has returns an empty page

steps.title: Send GET /products/search with q set to a unique name that no product has.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is an empty array and from is null.

specs.title: API-0028: Search without a term returns an empty page

steps.title: Send GET /products/search without query parameters.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is an empty array and from is null.

specs.title: API-0029: Search with an empty term returns an empty page

steps.title: Send GET /products/search with an empty q.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is an empty array and from is null.

specs.title: API-0002: List products returns the first page of non-rental products

steps.title: Send GET /products without query parameters.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body has current_page, data, from, last_page, per_page, to and total.
Verify current_page is 1 and per_page is 9.
Verify data has at most 9 items.
Verify each item has id, name, description, price, is_location_offer, is_rental, co2_rating, in_stock, is_eco_friendly, product_image, a category with id, name and slug, and a brand with id and name.
Verify every item's is_rental is false.
Verify every item's in_stock is a boolean.
Verify every item's is_eco_friendly is true exactly when its co2_rating is A or B.

specs.title: API-0003: Filter by brand returns only that brand's products

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the brand id of the first item.
Send GET /products with by_brand set to that brand id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is not empty and every item's brand id equals that brand id.

specs.title: API-0004: Filter by category returns only that category's products

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the category id of the first item.
Send GET /products with by_category set to that category id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is not empty and every item's category id equals that category id.

specs.title: API-0005: Filter by category slug returns the category and its direct sub-categories

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's category id and slug.
Send GET /products with by_category_slug set to that slug.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is not empty.

Verify every item's category is that category or a direct sub-category of it: its category id equals that category id, or GET /products/{productId} for the item returns a category parent_id equal to that category id.

specs.title: API-0006: Rental filter returns only rental products

steps.title: Send GET /products with is_rental=true.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify every item's is_rental is true.

specs.title: API-0007: Price range filter returns only products in the range

steps.title: Send GET /products with between=price,10,30.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify every item's price is at least 10 and at most 30.

specs.title: API-0008: Sort by price descending orders the products by price

steps.title: Send GET /products with sort=price,desc.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the items' prices are in descending order.

specs.title: API-0009: Eco-friendly filter returns only products rated A or B

steps.title: Send GET /products with eco_friendly=true.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify every item's co2_rating is A or B (case-insensitive) and its is_eco_friendly is true.

specs.title: API-0010: Name filter returns only products whose name contains the text

steps.title: Send GET /products with q=pliers.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is not empty and every item's name contains "pliers" (case-insensitive).

specs.title: API-0011: Spec filter returns only products with that spec value

steps.title: Find a product with at least one spec: send GET /products/{productId} for the items of GET /products until one returns a non-empty specs array, and take its first spec's spec_name and spec_value.
Send GET /products with by_spec=<spec_name>:<spec_value>.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is not empty.
Verify every item's specs, from GET /products/{productId} for the item, include a spec with that spec_name and spec_value.

specs.title: API-0012: Page 2 returns the next products

steps.title: Send GET /products and keep the item ids of page 1.
Send GET /products with page=2.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify current_page is 2.
Verify no item id on page 2 is among the page 1 ids.

specs.title: API-0013: Unknown category id returns an empty list

steps.title: Send GET /products with by_category set to a well-formed ULID that no category has.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify data is an empty array.

specs.title: API-0052: Partially update product returns success

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PATCH /products/{productId} with that id and a body with only a new unique product name.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Verify GET /products/{productId} with that id returns the new name.

specs.title: API-0053: Partially update product with a non-numeric price returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PATCH /products/{productId} with that id and a body with only price set to the string "not-a-number".
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a price key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0054: Partially update product with a name longer than 120 characters returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PATCH /products/{productId} with that id and a body with only a 121-character name that starts with a unique product name.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a name key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0055: Partially update product with a description longer than 1250 characters returns 422

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PATCH /products/{productId} with that id and a body with only a 1251-character description.
Verify the response status is 422.
Verify the body has a description key with at least one message.

specs.title: API-0056: Partially update product with an unknown id returns 404

steps.title: Send PATCH /products/{productId} with a well-formed ULID that no product has and a body with only a unique product name.
Verify the response status is 404.
Verify the body's message is "Requested item not found".

specs.title: API-0076: Partially update product category, brand and image saves the new values

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id, and from other items of GET /products a brand id, a category id and a product image id that differ from them.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, the first item's ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PATCH /products/{productId} with that id and a body with only the other category id, brand id and product image id.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id.
Verify its category id, brand id and product_image id equal the other ids.

specs.title: API-0077: Partially update product location offer and rental flags saves the new values

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, those ids, is_location_offer false and is_rental false, and take the new product's id.
Send PATCH /products/{productId} with that id and a body with only is_location_offer true and is_rental true.
Verify the response status is 200.
Verify the body's success is true.
Send GET /products/{productId} with that id.
Verify its is_location_offer is true and its is_rental is true.

specs.title: API-0033: Create product returns 201 with the new product

steps.title: Send GET /products and take the first item's brand id, category id and product image id.
Send POST /products with a unique product name, a positive price, that category id, brand id and product image id, is_location_offer false and is_rental false.
Verify the response status is 201.
